newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus plane lands in Rhodes after screen cracks.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus plane lands in Rhodes after screen cracks.

text.p: An Airbus 320 airplane of Cypriot charter firm Eurocypria with 174 Russian tourists on board landed on the Greek island of Rhodes on Wednesday night after one of its windscreens showed cracks, an airline spokesman said.
The plane was on its way to Cyprus from Saint Petersburg when cracks developed in one of the five layers on the windscreen in the cockpit.

"The decision to land was taken purely preventatively and it was at the discretion of the captain whether he wanted to continue the trip or land the plane. He decided to land it," said spokesman Tassos Angeli.
Eurocypria is the subsidiary of Cyprus Airways, Cyprus's national carrier.
The flight, number ECA843, was due to land in the western town of Paphos at 7.30 p.m. (1630 GMT) and in Larnaca at 8.30 p.m.
Angeli said another plane would fly out from Larnaca to pick up the Russian passengers, with a team of airline engineers to assess the state of the grounded plane.
